title: design - textures package
text: quad mesh regular grid completely determined tiny recipe: grid dimension (nx, ny cells), extent (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax), y orientation (ydown). Everything textures view recipe level materialization: quad_spec() - recipe , plain serializable list, nothing materialized quad_edges() - unexpanded intermediate, x y coordinates cell edges two short vectors (nx + 1 ny + 1 values) quad_index(), quad_vertex() - materialized components, 4 x (nx * ny) vertex index expanded vertex coordinates quad_mesh(), quad(), quad_texture() - assembled ‘mesh3d’ objects ‘mesh3d’ objects constructed directly (rgl required, lives Suggests). rgl installed plot plot3d(), shade3d(), persp3d(), wire3d(), dot3d(), .mesh3d() works quad_spec via delayed S3 registration. 2D base graphics plot() method included.

title: design - textures package
text: Default extent unit square, “y-” (y begins 0). Quads emitted cell order, x fastest - matrix()/image() convention, raster cell order ydown = TRUE. Face-indexed values (colours, na.rm) align grid cell order. Quad vertex winding counter-clockwise, required rgl (see material3d back argument). ydown flips orientation y coordinates begin top count , rotates index cycle winding remains correct. Texture coordinates extent-normalized vertex coordinates, remain valid mesh whose vertices lie extent. Mesh density (dimension) independent pixel dimension texture image: coarse mesh may carry full-resolution image, graphics engine interpolates within quad. Coordinate transformation belongs outside core: mesh vertex matrix interchange, transform (e.g. reproj) texture drapes unchanged.

text: Mercator raster single quad. Zoom translate pivot. Maps image onto quad PNG file. Run code zoom . texture map quad Maps fun R just geography. texture map quad
code: library(textures) ## create a temporary file and write an image to it tfile <- tempfile(fileext = ".png") png::writePNG(ga_topo$img/255, tfile)  ## create a quad *canvas*, a single 4-corner shape floating in 3D ## (and use the PNG file as the material to texture that canvas) quad0 <- quad_texture(c(1, 1), extent = ga_topo$extent, texture = tfile, )   ## plot it in 3D  rgl::open3d() rgl::plot3d(quad0, specular = "black") set_scene()  ## this sets the plot up to appear like a 2D image library(ggplot2) library(rgl) ## create a plot and save it g <- ggplot(mpg, aes(displ, fill = drv)) +    geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.5) +    facet_wrap(~drv, ncol = 1) g  tfile <- tempfile(fileext = ".png") ggsave(tfile, g)   library(textures) quad0 <- quad_texture(dimension = c(92, 102), texture = tfile)  ex <- -20 ## flip it (fixme later) quad0$vb[1L, ] <- 1-quad0$vb[1L, ] quad0$vb[2L, ] <- 1-quad0$vb[2L, ]  quad0$vb[1L,] <- scales::rescale(quad0$vb[1,], to = c(-1, 1) * ex) quad0$vb[2L,] <- scales::rescale(quad0$vb[2L,], to = c(-1, 1) * ex)  f <- function(x, y) { r <- sqrt(x^2+y^2); 10 * sin(r)/r }  ## ?persp quad0$vb[3L, ] <- f(quad0$vb[1L,], quad0$vb[2L,])  ## not working atm ... #quad0 <- addNormals(quad0)  ## we are still in rgl scope, so everything is available ## plot it in 3D  rgl::open3d() rgl::plot3d(quad0, specular = "black") rgl::aspect3d(1, 1, .3) #set_scene(phi = 15, interactive = TRUE) par3d(windowRect  = c(0, 0, 1024, 1024))

title: Quad mesh primitives — quad_index
text: quad_index() gives index four corner vertices every cell, 4 x (nx * ny) matrix 1-based vertex indexes. Quads cell order, x fastest (matrix() image() convention, raster cell order ydown = TRUE). Winding counter-clockwise y-grids. quad_edges() gives unexpanded form vertices, x y coordinates cell edges two vectors length nx + 1 ny + 1. compact intermediate: full vertex set outer expansion, many purposes (transform bounds, axis coordinates, texture alignment) margins needed. quad_vertex() gives materialized vertices, (nx + 1) * (ny + 1) row matrix x, y coordinates, x fastest, matching index quad_index(). large grids vertex count index length exceeds integer maximum, quad_index() returns matrix doubles (exact integer values 2^53), R subsetting 'mesh3d' usage accept natively. Take care apply .integer() index.

title: textures: Quad Mesh Primitives and Texture Mapping for Grids — textures-package
text: Generate quad mesh primitives compact specification regular grid, dimension extent. Provides fast generation mesh indexes vertices, unexpanded intermediate form (grid edge coordinates), compact serializable specification meshes generated demand. Meshes 'mesh3d' objects used 'rgl' package, constructed without requiring graphics engine, support texture mapping (Heckbert (1986) doi:10.1109/MCG.1986.276672 ) image draped mesh whose density independent image resolution. C++ header library installed packages may generate mesh components via 'LinkingTo'.

title: textures 0.1.0
text: Preparing CRAN release, textures now core mesh-generation package quadmesh import. quad header library vendored inst/include/textures/quad.h, removing GitHub-‘quad’ dependency. packages may use via LinkingTo: textures. Behaviour change: quads now emitted cell order, x fastest (matrix()/image() convention, raster cell order ydown = TRUE). Previously C++ path emitted quads y fastest. Vertices unchanged; column order ib (face-value alignment) changes. New core primitives quad_index(), quad_edges(), quad_vertex(). quad_edges() unexpanded intermediate form (grid margin coordinates). quad_index() transparently returns double storage grids whose vertex count index length exceeds integer maximum. New compact specification form quad_spec(), plain serializable recipe generatable mesh, quad_mesh() materialize mesh3d. rgl installed, .mesh3d() also works quad_spec (delayed S3 registration). rgl scales longer Imports: mesh3d objects constructed directly, rgl (Suggests) needed 3D display. set_scene() png_plot3d() require rgl runtime. plot.mesh3d() rewritten base graphics (previously used grid gridBase, declared dependencies); triangle branch indexing bug fixed. quad_texture() empty texture path now warns ‘texture file given’ rather ‘texture file given exist’.
